_comment: 2026-10-27: no routes since the retired release train (its per-window DIGEST and needs-action kinds were the only rows) was removed (operator directive); the mechanism stays inert. Operator 2026-10-21 ('email yes'): named comms-intent kinds also go to email, in addition to the incident notifier's Telegram P2 batch. Read by scripts/incident_notifier.py only. When a live P2 message that carries one of these comms-intent incidents is SENT, the notifier sends ONE email with those incidents' lines through the communications gateway (scripts/lib/comms/channel_adapters.send_via_gateway, channel 'email' -> the approved adapter scripts/alerting.send_email; recipient REPORT_EMAIL_TO is read by that adapter, never here). Only P2 (DIGEST) incidents from the n8n comms-intent source are mirrored; P1 is never mirrored. The gateway mode gate applies (SHADOW records, never delivers). Changed only by reviewed PR. 2026-11-09 (LQ-20261107-1702, DSN-20261109 REV 3 H): the two numbers-truth kinds are the first live routes. A NEW ticket already pages email+Telegram+Fi text immediately through the D34 critical-alert hub (scripts/lib/critical_channels); its intent still rides the next P2 batch, so this row is the second, later email copy that survives a page that could not be sent. A cleared line has no page path at all, so its row is what carries it to email; cleared never uses the text channel.
